title: {rival} cuts prices
line: Their {category} undercuts yours in {city}.

title: Windsunk tribute due
line: The Council's collector is at your door.

title: A Veilwalker offers a trade
line: Spiritweed, for a vow.

title: The Friars come knocking
line: Inspection of your stock.

title: A keg has turned
line: Sour smell from the cellar.

title: One more round?
line: A big spender begs a pour past close.

title: {staff} wants a raise
line: Morale is slipping behind the bar.

title: Shorelan wardens sniffing
line: Someone saw tonic poured in Aleforge.

title: {rival} courts your staff
line: {staff} has an offer on the table.

title: Thugs hired against you
line: {rival} has paid a gang to start fights at your tavern this season.

title: Cellar door jimmied
line: Someone got at your kegs overnight.

title: Hall of Ale brewing contest
line: Enter your best pour.

title: John Cum offers a contract
line: Grain, cheap, if you buy only from him.

title: {tavern}: run a promo?
line: Your manager wants a promo night.

title: {tavern}: raise prices?
line: Your manager thinks the room can bear it.

title: {tavern}: buy kegs in bulk?
line: Cheaper kegs for a few seasons.

title: Aleforge picks a mayor
line: Thatcher the historian is on the ballot.

title: The Trials will return!
line: Thatcher Sr. seeks a sponsor for 463.

title: The Beerchelli murmurs
line: Old prophecy rattles every taproom.

title: Addy's Sweep
line: Friars tighten their grip on Providence.

title: The Windsunk Levy
line: The Council taxes every tavern in town.

title: Taboo Tide in Roto
line: The after-dark market is being raided.

title: Blight at the Cumstead
line: Grain prices spike across the Isles.

title: The Veil turns
line: Strange luck settles on your cellars.

title: A rival proposes a truce
line: {rival} wants to fix prices against the rest.

title: The truce is exposed
line: Everyone knows you fixed prices.

title: Rum Ridge showmen in town
line: They'll pack your hall, for a price.

title: Cellar flood!
line: Save the stock, the fixtures, or the night.

title: Your best hand is poached
line: {rival} offers {staff} double wages.

title: Clipped Duckets scandal
line: Bad coin passed through your till.

title: Stormtide wreckers
line: Ships are going down off the cliffs.

title: The Ashen Oath threatens fire
line: Stop pouring grog, or else.

title: Shorelan raid
line: Wardens sweep Aleforge for tonic.

title: A bard wants the stage
line: A travelling bard offers a night of songs for a small fee.

title: Dockhands bring their own mugs
line: A crew wants cheaper pours in mugs they brought.

title: The well has gone brackish
line: Your water tastes of salt; the brews will suffer.

title: A regular wants a tab
line: {staff} vouches for them: they'll pay at month's end.

title: A keg bursts on the stairs
line: Beer everywhere; the cellar stairs are a mess.

title: A wedding party wants the room
line: They'll pay well, but your regulars will be turned away.

title: The tax man counts your taps
line: A City Hall clerk asks about unpaid tap tax.

title: Sailors want a shanty night
line: A ship's crew will sing all night if the grog is cheap.

title: {rival}'s tapster is fed up
line: They offer {rival}'s recipes for a price.

title: Wasps in the cider
line: A nest in the eaves; patrons are getting stung.

title: A City Hall aide is drunk
line: He's loud, drunk, and still ordering.

title: Bells ring for vespers
line: The Friars ask you to close before the bells.

title: The pump handle snaps
line: One tap is out until it's fixed.

title: A dice game gets loud
line: Table four is betting big and shouting louder.

title: A cart of cheap hops
line: Half-price hops off a cart, no questions asked.

title: Rats in the cellar
line: Your cellar has rats, and they like barley.

title: Fog keeps the ships in
line: Crews stuck ashore want somewhere to drink.

title: A painter offers a mural
line: A wall painting for a few Duckets and free drinks.

title: Card sharps at table four
line: Someone's fleecing your patrons.

title: A patron falls ill
line: Too much of something. Everyone is watching.

title: A famous drinker visits
line: Word spreads that a legend is at your bar.

title: A pickpocket in the crowd
line: Patrons are missing their purses.

options.label: Hire a watchman
options.hint: Fewer brawls and thefts this season

title: The Hall of Ale inspects
line: Brewers' Lane checks your casks.

title: Old Lagendale coins
line: A patron pays in coins from the old empire.

title: Two regulars feud
line: Old friends, new grudge, same bar.

title: Talk of a hops blight
line: Farmers say this year's hops are sick.

options.label: Stock up now
options.hint: Kegs cost 15% less for two seasons

title: A ship's crew wants credit
line: They'll pay in favour when their ship comes in.

title: The candles are burning low
line: The room is getting dark and gloomy.

title: A cook wants your kitchen
line: Stew and bread would keep patrons longer.

title: {rival} tells a story
line: They say your kegs are watered down.

options.label: Pay for a retraction
options.hint: The story dies before it spreads

title: The Friars bless your taps
line: A Friar offers a blessing, for a donation.

title: A drinking contest
line: Two crews want to settle a bet at your bar.

title: The night watch drops in
line: Free pours for the watch, and they'll keep an eye out.

options.label: Pour for them
options.hint: Fewer brawls and thefts this season

title: The cellar floods
line: Water's coming in; the kegs are at risk.

title: A stray wanders in
line: The patrons have already named it.

title: A Tide Caller wants to play
line: Songs of the deep, for a small fee.

title: The Magnate's collector
line: A surprise fee for your sign on the market street.

title: Street party on Brewers' Lane
line: The whole Lane is out; set up a stall?

title: Pilgrims ask for rest
line: Weary pilgrims want a quiet corner and water.

title: Smugglers offer cheap barrels
line: Cheap kegs, if you don't ask where from.

title: It's {staff}'s birthday
line: The staff want to throw a little party.

title: {tavern}: the roof leaks
line: Your manager says rain is getting in.

title: {tavern}: a local brewer
line: A local brewer offers cheaper kegs for a year.

options.label: Sign the deal
options.hint: Kegs cost 15% less here for two seasons

title: {tavern}: a town festival
line: Your manager wants a stall at the festival.

title: {tavern}: staff want more
line: The staff are grumbling about their pay.

title: {tavern}: trouble at the door
line: Your manager wants a watchman on the door.

options.label: Hire a watchman
options.hint: Fewer brawls and thefts for two seasons

title: {tavern}: cheaper pours?
line: Your manager wants to trim prices to fill the room.

options.label: Trim prices
options.hint: 10% cheaper pours, more patrons, this season

title: {tavern}: a new sign
line: A carved sign would catch passers-by.

title: {tavern}: cellar clear-out
line: Old kegs are going off in the cellar.

title: A shipping line's offer
line: Armed escorts on every voyage, for a season fee.

options.label: Hire the escorts
options.hint: Much safer shipments for three seasons

title: Scholars from Hoegaarden
line: Library scholars want to write about your taverns.

title: Veilwalkers pass through
line: They ask for shelter on their walk.

title: Sponsor the harvest fair
line: Your name on every banner at the fair.
